# Arachnids
Arachnids are a species of large bipedal arthropods that has evolved to manipulate objects akin to other sapient species. They posses 8 limbs, only 2 of which have the ability to manipulate objects and only 2 are capable of supporting their body weight, and 8 eyes as well as a large set of fanged mandibles. Their body is covered by a fuzzy exoskeleton.
## Racial Features - Their blood is [color=#ffa500]copper[/color] based, thus being metabolised from it. - Their blood has a distinct blue color. - They can [color=#1e90ff]eat raw meat without any ill effects[/color], but [color=#ffa500]some foods like chocolate or onions are poisonous[/color]. - Due to their less efficient lungs, they take [color=#ffa500]50% more asphyxiation damage[/color] and recover from it [color=#ffa500]50% slower[/color]. - They posses sharp fangs which let them deal [color=red]5[/color] piercing damage with unarmed attacks. - They posses additional sets of limbs, granting them [color=#1e90ff]2 extra pocket slots[/color]. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Sericulture
Arachnids can create Websilk at the cost of getting hungrier, consuming about 4% of their total hunger to produce one bundle of it. They can craft bundles of websilk into various items from clothing and shields to entire walls.
## Chittin The arachnid language, known as Chittin, is composed of a complex series of fast clicks generated by the rubbing of antenna. Often described as harsh and sharp sounding, Chittin is an uncommon language to hear in the galaxy due to most species being incapable of producing the sounds necessary to speak it without special implants.
## Age and Names Arachnids have a lifespan similar to that of humans, reaching adulthood at 20 years of age and being able to live up to 150. Arachnid names are given to them upon hatching, often being composed of 3 or more sillables and having been described as "Latin sounding".
